_comment: Three surfaces the glTF material model cannot describe, so that the OpenPBR
path is exercised by something other than a re-spelled metallic-roughness
material. Each names a parameter that openpbr_from_gltf.h can never reach:
base_diffuse_roughness is hardcoded to 0 there, glTF has no fuzz lobe (its
sheen is a different distribution), and KHR_materials_clearcoat has no
darkening of what lies beneath it.
Carried on a Cornell box on purpose: the estimator A/B that validates this
path renders with BSDF sampling alone, which does not converge against a
small emitter. A big area light is the point of the room.

materials._why: base_diffuse_roughness -- retroreflective diffuse, no glTF equivalent
fuzz -- an LTC microflake layer, not glTF's Charlie sheen
coat_darkening -- the coat absorbs into the base; glTF's does not
